mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT has remained deeply negative and worsened to -23.4 at t-0, signaling suppressed station footfall that drags down adjacent retail visits; RETAIL_REC will be lower over the next 28 days.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean exceeds last 28-day mean while TRANSIT remains below -20%.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT falls below -20% (observed -23.4 at t-0), policy or fear restricts movement; retail footfall declines over the next 2 weeks as discretionary trips are deferred.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 14 days despite TRANSIT staying below -20%.

mechanism_narrative: Residential mobility above +7% combined with workplaces below -25% indicates people are home-bound; this crowds out discretionary retail trips, lowering RETAIL_REC over 2 weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 14-day mean is higher than last 14-day mean while RESIDENTIAL > +7 and WORKPLACES < -25.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening-restrictions regime marked by PARKS below -25% and RESIDENTIAL above +7%, retail and recreation falls over the next week because outdoor and social trips are curtailed.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 7 days while PARKS < -25 and RESIDENTIAL > +7.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS volatility around -25 to -31 indicates weather-sensitive outdoor seasonality; as outdoor conditions stabilize, PARKS-led trips lift RETAIL_REC over the next 2 weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 14-day mean is lower than last 14-day mean while PARKS improves by more than 5 points from t-0.

mechanism_narrative: A joint rebound in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES above -20% and -25% respectively would indicate restored commuting; this raises weekday retail footfall, producing higher RETAIL_REC over 4 weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is lower than last 28-day mean even though TRANSIT rises above -20% and WORKPLACES above -25%.

mechanism_narrative: A RESIDENTIAL rise above +9% (observed +10.0 at t-0) signals voluntary or mandated home confinement that reduces non-essential retail trips over the next week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 7 days while RESIDENTIAL remains above +9%.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM stays near baseline while WORKPLACES and TRANSIT are below -20%, essential-only mobility dominates; discretionary RETAIL_REC falls over 4 weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean exceeds last 28-day mean while GROCERY_PHARM > -5 and WORKPLACES < -20 and TRANSIT < -20.
